categories.main_business_segments: Amkor operates as a single business segment focused on outsourced semiconductor packaging and test services. Its offerings are categorized into Advanced Products (such as flip chip, wafer-level processing, and related test services) and Mainstream Products (including wirebond packaging, power device packaging, and related test services).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Amkor specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging technologies such as flip chip, wafer-level chip scale packaging (CSP), wafer-level fan-out (WLFO), SWIFT (high-density fan-out), and advanced system-in-package (SiP) modules. The company employs high-volume manufacturing processes, including wafer bumping, wafer probe, die attach, wirebonding, molding, and advanced test services, with a strong focus on miniaturization, heterogeneous integration, and high-density interconnects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Amkor serves integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), fabless semiconductor companies, OEMs, and contract foundries. Its end markets include communications (smartphones, tablets), automotive and industrial (ADAS, electrification, infotainment), consumer electronics (AR/gaming, wearables, connected home), and computing (data center, infrastructure, PC/laptop, storage). Major customers include Apple (20.6% of 2022 sales) and Qualcomm (10.1%).
categories.geographic_coverage: Amkor has a geographically diverse manufacturing footprint with facilities in Korea, Japan, China, Malaysia, the Philippines, Portugal, Taiwan, and a new site under construction in Vietnam. Its customer base is global, with significant sales in the United States, Asia-Pacific, Japan, and EMEA regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Amkor operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain, providing packaging and test services after wafer fabrication but before final product assembly. It acts as a key outsourced partner between wafer foundries and electronics OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Amkor's strategy emphasizes leadership in advanced packaging for megatrends such as 5G, automotive, IoT, and high-performance computing. R&D priorities include miniaturization, heterogeneous integration, wafer- and panel-level packaging, high-density SiP modules, and environmentally friendly packaging. The company invests heavily in technology development, with about 700 R&D employees and $149 million in R&D expenses in 2022.
categories.revenue_model: Amkor generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor packaging and test services, recognized as services are rendered. The company offers turnkey solutions, including wafer bump, probe, assembly, and various test services, with pricing reflecting the customized nature of each project.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Amkor faces strong competition from established outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers such as ASE Technology Holding and JCET Group, as well as from internal IDM capabilities and foundries like TSMC and Samsung. Amkor is positioned as a technology leader in advanced packaging, with a broad service portfolio and long-standing relationships with major semiconductor companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Amkor reported net sales of $7.1 billion, up 15.5% from 2021, with a gross margin of 18.8% and net income of $766 million. The company has demonstrated consistent growth, driven by advanced product sales, and maintains a strong liquidity position with over $1.2 billion in cash and short-term investments. Capital expenditures were $908 million in 2022, focused on advanced packaging and new capacity in Vietnam.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Amkor differentiates itself through its leadership in advanced packaging technologies, broad service offerings, high-volume manufacturing expertise, and global manufacturing footprint. The company emphasizes innovation, quality, reliability, and the ability to support customers' needs for miniaturization, integration, and rapid time-to-market, making it a preferred partner for leading semiconductor companies.
